Honeypot field — invisible to humans, catches bots

div.div: Raw HTML → Hugo — Single index.html → full content/layout structure with blog support
layouts/_default/ fix — Missing underscore caused Hugo to find no templates
baseURL asset fix — Production URL in hugo.toml broke local asset paths — fixed with baseURL = "/"
Blog visibility bug — .reveal class set opacity:0 — IntersectionObserver missed viewport trigger
Native ToC — Hugo's TableOfContents replaced broken JS DOM scraping approach
Formspree security — reCAPTCHA blocked AJAX — replaced with honeypot + validation + rate limiting
Branch migration — portfolio → main: resolved conflicts, updated deploy.yml, switched to GH Actions
GH Pages permissions — Deploy branch not authorized in github-pages environment settings
Light theme rebuild — Warm #f5f5ef washed out → cool grey #f0f2f5 (GitHub/VS Code convention)
Card display fix — WordCount → Date.Format "Jan 2006" on project cards

Built with Hugo · Styled from scratch · Deployed on GitHub Pages from main
